text.overview: Ossa Mountain is climbed by its east ridge, a long day from the Squamish side with steep forest, meadows and creek crossings below a route-finding scramble. Near the top the route downclimbs into a notch and works through a chimney section before the summit.
text.descent: Return the same way; the downclimbs and loose ground make the descent as serious as the ascent.

text.description: A maintained trail climbs from Wolverton through forest to Panther Gap, then across a meadow and past Tharps Rock to switchbacks on the summit. Long day with about 4,000 feet of gain.

text.description: A remote peak reached off the John Muir Trail near Muir Pass; leave the trail for Black Giant Pass, then walk up about half a mile of loose rock to the summit. The east-side approach over Echo Col from Lake Sabrina adds class 3 and possible snow.

text.description: Follow Summit Creek trail about 10 miles to Lunch Meadow, leave the trail before Mosquito Pass, and climb a drainage to the summit ridge.

name: Via Coyote Pass and the Saddle

text.description: A very long approach: from the trailhead go over Farewell Gap, south along the trail to Coyote Pass, then cross-country to the saddle between the two summits. A short boulder scramble finishes the climb. Water can be scarce on the trail.

Follow the Pacific Crest Trail north about five miles to Clover Meadow, then leave it and climb roughly 3,000 ft west through dense manzanita to the ridge. The true highpoint is the northern rock group, a short distance beyond the lower southern summit, with some class 3 on the ridge.
Cross Kearsarge Pass, descend to Bubbs Creek, and head up Vidette Creek cross-country. Climb the northeast buttress to the lower northwest summit and traverse to the high point.

text.description: Follow the trail past two meadows to a faint side trail, then leave it near 8,800 ft and go cross-country over sage slopes to the southwest ridge. The summit hump is steep talus.
Leave the parking area cross-country up the southeast slopes, cross low scrub, then slog talus to the broad plateau and the summit. Easy terrain overall but the talus is loose.
